subject: Endcap accessibility and AV rental schedule for Expo West
messages:
From: Allison Park <allison@exposolutions.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Endcap layout + accessibility notes (Expo West)

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Attached is the latest endcap sketch for your island near Aisle 2 (see ExpoFloor_Endcap_Sketch_v3.png). A few things I wanted to call out that affect AV and accessibility: 

- The endcap faces a main footpath; there will be intermittent crowds — we recommend a low barrier, 3ft clear path on the left side for ADA access.
- Ceiling rigging is limited in that zone (max 40 kg at rig points).
- Power: we can provide a single 20A drop at the center back; if you need more, we'll need an electrical order and at least 72 hours lead time.
- Streaming: facility allows camera on a tripod at the corner but no fixed booms without additional approval.

Can AV Rentals Co provide a quote for: one compact encoder kit (for livestream), two compact speakers, one wireless lav, and a 12ft truss for banner lighting that stays within the 40kg limit? Please include freight and install windows.

Attaching the sketch for reference. Would like to lock the AV order by Friday if possible.

Thanks,
Allison
Allison Park
Senior Event Manager, Expo Solutions
[Attachment: ExpoFloor_Endcap_Sketch_v3.png (PNG, 1 page)]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Allison Park <allison@exposolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Endcap layout + accessibility notes (Expo West)

Allison — thanks for the quick layout and notes. Agree on the clear path requirement; we want to make sure our demo flow doesn't block it. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Can you confirm the exact coordinates of the center back power drop (so our AV vendor can quote cable runs)?
- For the 40 kg rig limit, is that per rigging point or per truss span?

Ben, looping you in to get an estimate and confirm whether we can fit the encoder + speakers in the endcap footprint without crowding the demo. Marissa, can you confirm if we want the livestream to be on a continuous feed (brand channel) or a short rolling demo loop? That changes encoder complexity.

If we lock by EOD Friday it gives me time to route a PO before vendor cutoffs.

Best,
Logan Wright
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks — looked at the sketch and Allison's notes. AV Rentals Co: see our requested list below and the rough install windows (we're flexible but prefer the earlier slot):

Requested equipment:
- 1x LiveU LU800 encoder (rack with power),
- 2x compact FOH speakers (QTY 2), wall/stand mount options,
- 1x wireless lav mic (receiver + spare battery),
- 1x 12ft lightweight truss + LED wash lights (total hanging load <40kg),
- Cables & labor for install (single 20A back-of-booth to amp/encoder).

Install window: October 18, 09:00–12:00 preferred (exhibitor access opens 08:00; we want to be demo-ready at noon).
Strike / deinstall: Oct 20, 18:00–21:00.

Can you confirm: freight arrival timing (to dock), total install labor hours, and an all-in cost? If you can produce an AV_Quote_0426.pdf I can route a PO. Also confirm that the truss spec meets the 40 kg per-point requirement; if not we will drop to two light bars instead.

Ben Carter
Vendor Ops & Events | Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Endcap accessibility + AV order (PO and install windows)

Hi all — final confirmation and next steps. AV Rentals Co has provided the attached quote (AV_Quote_0426.pdf) and confirms they can meet the 40kg per rigging-point constraint by using a lightweight truss and LED bars rather than heavier fixtures. Summary below: 

- Confirmed equipment: LU800 encoder, 2x compact FOH speakers, 1x wireless lav, 12ft lightweight truss, cables, install & teardown labor.
- Total all-in: $4,620 (includes install, freight to dock, insurance).
- Install window: Oct 18, 09:00–11:30 (crew will arrive at dock 08:30).
- Deinstall window: Oct 20, 18:00–20:30.
- Power: center back 20A drop confirmed by Facility Ops (facops@conventioncenter.org). If you need a second drop we must submit an electrical order by Oct 6.

Allison: can you confirm that the 3ft clear ADA path on the left is acceptable. Ben, please proceed to issue PO #RI-99821 once Allison signs off and AV Rentals confirms final install ETA. I've uploaded the signed floor sketch and PO to the shared drive (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleEndcapAssets
